_comment: Services shown in PRTS Control, in start order. 'unit' is a systemd --user unit. Copy this file to ~/.config/prts-control/services.json to change it without editing the repo. 'confirm_stop' asks before stopping. 'terminal' adds a Terminal button that runs this command in a terminal window.

services.label: Local model
services.when_off: Backends set to openai-compatible (or auto, while Claude is off) get no answers from the local model. Frees its GPU memory.

services.label: Discord bot
services.when_off: PRTS is offline on Discord: no slash commands, no music, no replies at all.

services.label: Claude narrator
services.detail: Claude Code session for the claude-code backend
services.when_off: Backends set to claude-code get an offline notice; with auto, the fallback model answers instead (if it is running).
services.terminal_hint: Opens the narrator's live Claude Code screen. Close the window or press Ctrl+B then D to leave it running. Anything you type goes to the narrator.
